name: Biała Królikowska
what: A village in the gmina of Grodziec and parish of Królików, with manor and peasant land, 15 houses and 140 inhabitants in 1827 and 334 inhabitants later.

name: Białobłoty
what: Sub-entry 1 of Białobłoty: a colony in the gmina of Grodziec and parish of Królików, 1896 morgi, 100 houses and 788 inhabitants in 1827, 1314 inhabitants later.

name: Borowiec
what: Two colonies, Old and New Borowiec, in the gmina of Grodziec and parish of Królików, with 1463 and 662 morgi of peasant land and 782 and 222 inhabitants; 61 houses and 590 inhabitants together in 1827.

name: Ciżwica
what: Two villages, Ciżwica Nowa and Stara (also called Great and Little), in the gmina of Grodziec and parish of Królików, with 120 and 430 inhabitants and 327 and 596 morgi of peasant land.

name: Dąbrowa
what: Sub-entry 3 of Dąbrowa: a village in powiat koniński, gmina and parish of Rzgów; no figures given.

name: Defekt
what: A settlement in powiat kaliski, gmina and parish of Zbiersk; no figures given.

name: Długa Wieś
what: A village and colony in powiat kaliski, gmina Zbiersk (printed Zbierak), parish Stawiszyn, forming an estate of 101 włók with five nomenklatury, with 28 houses and 255 inhabitants in 1827.
note: Its estate (once the starostwo of Stawiszyn) also listed Magdalenów, Czerwieniec, Wirginia, Pólko and Kionczyn (Kiączyn).

name: Dłuska
what: A village in the gmina of Dłusk and parish of Pyzdry, 15 houses and 186 inhabitants in 1827; the entry adds that the gmina's court district seat and post office are at Pyzdry.

name: Dziewin
what: A village in the gmina of Grodziec and parish of Królików; no figures given.

name: Gorazdówka
what: A village in the gmina of Dłusk and parish of Pyzdry; no figures given.

name: Górki
what: Sub-entry 17 of Górki: a village on the Warta in powiat koniński, gmina and parish of Rzgów, 10 versts from Konin, 139 morgi and 27 inhabitants.

name: Grądy
what: Sub-entry 7 of Grądy: a manor farm near the Warta in powiat koniński, gmina and parish of Rzgów, 12 versts from Konin, 435 morgi and 8 inhabitants, formerly part of the estate of Rzgów.
note: Powiat koniński; not the Grądy of the Grodziec gmina (next row but one).

name: Grądy
what: Sub-entry 9 of Grądy: the colonies New and Old Grądy in powiat słupecki, gmina and parish of Grodziec, with 43 and 37 houses and 360 and 267 inhabitants in 1827.

name: Groby żydowskie
what: A place named Groby żydowskie in powiat słupecki, gmina Dłusk, parish Pyzdry; no kind or figures given.

name: Holendry Pyzdrskie
what: Sub-entry 24 of the Holendry run: Holendry pyzdrskie in powiat słupecki, gmina Dłusk, parish Pyzdry; no figures given.

name: Huta Stara and Huta Nowa
what: Sub-entry 91: Huta stara and Huta nowa in powiat słupecki, gmina Grodziec (with a cross-reference 'ob.'), parish Królików; no figures given.

name: Janów
what: Sub-entry 32 of a run of J. entries: a manor farm in powiat słupecki, gmina and parish of Grodziec, 32 versts from Słupca, 1 house and 16 inhabitants; compare Grodziec.
note: Headword from its numbered run (Janów 32); "Por. Grodziec".

name: Janowo
what: Sub-entry 5 of Janowo: a village in powiat słupecki, gmina and parish of Grodziec, 32 versts from Słupca, belonging to the village of Grodziec, 6 houses.

name: Jezierki
what: A settlement in powiat kaliski, gmina Zbiersk, parish Stawiszyn, 18 versts from Kalisz, 2 houses.

name: Józefów
what: Sub-entry 18 of Józefów: a colony in powiat kaliski, gmina Chocz, parish Stawiszyn, 30 versts from Kalisz, 61 houses and 647 inhabitants.

name: Junno
what: A village on the Bawół in powiat słupecki, gmina and parish of Grodziec, 33 versts from Słupca, with Mokre and Huta nowa 45 houses and 279 inhabitants; 12 houses and 125 inhabitants in 1827.

name: Kiączyn
what: A village, colony and manor farm in powiat kaliski, gmina Zbiersk, parish Stawiszyn, 16 versts from Kalisz, 22 houses and 216 inhabitants in 1827.

name: Królików
what: A village and manor farm on the Zwiernik, gmina Grodziec, parish Królików, 28 versts from Słupca, with a brick parish church 'of the 12th century', belonging to the Grodziec estate; the parish had 2899 souls.

name: Lądek
what: A village and manor farm on the Bawół brook, gmina Grodziec, parish Królików, 30 versts from Słupca, village 24 houses and 226 inhabitants, folwark 2 houses and 20 inhabitants; see Grodziec.
note: Not the town of Lądek (gmina Ciążeń), which the register has: a village of the Grodziec estate.

name: Lesiaki
what: Sub-entry 1 of Lesiaki: a settlement in powiat słupecki, gmina Dłusk, parish Pyzdry, 24 versts from Słupca, 1 house.

name: Lipice
what: A village and manor farm on the Bawół brook, gmina Grodziec, parish Królików, 30.5 versts from Słupca, village 5 houses and 120 inhabitants, folwark 1 house and 15 inhabitants; see Grodziec.

name: Lisieniec
what: Sub-entry 1 of Lisieniec: a village in powiat koniński, gmina and parish of Rzgów, 14.5 versts west of Konin, 2 versts from the Warta, 121 morgi and 61 inhabitants.

name: Lubiny
what: Sub-entry 2 of Lubiny: a colony in powiat koniński, gmina Dąbroszyn, parish Zbiersk, 24 versts south of Konin, 353 morgi and 322 mixed Polish-German inhabitants.

name: Łagiewniki
what: Sub-entry 5 of Łagiewniki: a village and manor farm in powiat słupecki, gmina Grodziec, parish Królików, 27 versts from Słupca, village 19 houses and 245 inhabitants, folwark 2 houses and 17 inhabitants.

name: Magdalenów
what: A manor farm in the gmina of Zbiersk and parish of Stawiszyn, 18 versts from Kalisz, with 2 houses and 14 inhabitants, belonging to the estate of Długa Wieś.

name: Modlica
what: A village on the Prosna with a border-guard post, in the gmina of Dłusk and parish of Pyzdry, 22 versts from Słupca, 6 houses and 62 inhabitants in the village and 1 house at the post.

name: Modła (al. Wydyrka)
what: A village (also called Wydyrka) in powiat koniński, gmina and parish of Rzgów, 15 versts west-southwest of Konin, with 28 houses and 229 inhabitants; formerly a manor farm of the Rzgów estate, now broken up.
note: Headword from its numbered run (Modła 7); once a farm of the Rzgów estate.

name: Orlina Mała
what: A colony in the gmina of Grodziec and parish of Królików, 24 versts from Słupca, with 28 houses, 189 inhabitants and 403 morgi, once part of the Grodziec estate.
note: Not your Orlina Duża, which has no entry of its own. But "Orliny, kol. nad strum. Białą, pow. koniński, gm. Rzgów, par. Królików, 24 versts from Konin, 54 houses, 546 inhabitants", on the same page, may be it.

name: Piskory
what: A colony with a forest settlement on the Bawół, in the gmina of Brudzew Kaliski and parish of Stawiszyn, 24 versts from Kalisz, 395 morgi, formerly part of the Lipe estate.

name: Podlesie
what: A forest settlement in the gmina and parish of Grodziec, 32 versts from Słupca, with 1 house and 4 inhabitants.

name: Podmłynek
what: A forest settlement in the gmina of Dłusk and parish of Pyzdry, 25 versts from Słupca, with 1 house.

name: Pólko
what: A manor farm in the gmina of Zbiersk and parish of Stawiszyn, 17 versts from Kalisz, with 1 house and 9 inhabitants, belonging to the Długa Wieś estate.
note: Belonged to the Wirginki estate, split off from Długa Wieś in 1879.

name: Przewóz
what: A settlement on the Warta in the gmina of Dłusk and parish of Pyzdry, 22 versts from Słupca, with 1 house.

name: Rodzany
what: A colony with a road guard post in the gmina of Ceków and parish of Stawiszyn, 23 versts from Kalisz; the colony has 29 houses and 232 inhabitants, the guard post 1 house and 5 inhabitants.

name: Ruda
what: A village and settlement on the Prosna on the border of the grand duchy of Poznań, in the gmina of Dłusk and parish of Pyzdry, 23 versts from Słupca, with 25 houses and 188 inhabitants.

name: Rzgów
what: The village, manor farm and estate of Rzgów on the Warta in powiat koniński, 19 versts from Konin, seat of the gmina and parish, with a wooden parish church; a ducal village given to the monastery at Ląd in 1145.
note: The parish seat. Already in the edition's register (the Kodeks charters of 1261 and 1280), not in your gazetteer.

name: Spławie
what: A border-guard settlement on the Warta in the gmina of Dłusk and parish of Pyzdry, 23 versts from Słupca, with 1 house, a part of a village Spławie in powiat wrzesiński.

name: Szyba
what: A manor farm and border-guard settlement on the Szyba stream (a tributary of the Prosna), in the gmina and parish of Pyzdry, 20.5 versts from Słupca, the farm with 2 houses and the guard post with 1.

name: Tarnowa
what: A village and manor farm on the Warta near the mouth of the Prosna, on the border of the grand duchy of Poznań, in the gmina of Dłusk and parish of Pyzdry, 20 versts from Słupca, with 21 houses and 276 inhabitants, a windmill and limestone and ore deposits; the Tarnowa estate also held the manor farm of Zamość and the village of Modlica.
note: Its estate listed the farm Zamość and the village Modlica (both on this list).

name: Walga
what: A manor farm and village in the gmina of Dłusk and parish of Pyzdry, 12 versts from Słupca, separated from the Rataje estate, with 380 morgi; the village has 5 settlements and 38 morgi.

name: Wałga
what: Two manor farms on the Warta in the gmina of Dłusk and parish of Pyzdry, 19 versts from Słupca, the first with 1 house and 13 inhabitants and the second with 1 house and 8 inhabitants.

name: Winnica
what: A settlement on the Warta in the gmina and parish of Pyzdry, 18 versts from Słupca, with 1 house and 2 inhabitants.
note: Not the Hohenlohe lordship Wieniec, which the documents sometimes spell "Winnica".

name: Wiory
what: A forest settlement in the gmina and parish of Grodziec, 35 versts from Słupca, referring the reader to Grodziec 2.

name: Wirginki
what: A manor farm in the gmina of Zbiersk and parish of Stawiszyn, 18 versts from Kalisz, with 2 houses and 28 inhabitants; the Wirginki estate, split off in 1879 from Długa Wieś (also called Stawiszyn), comprised the farms Wirginki and Pólko, 925 morgi in all.

name: Wiry
what: A place in powiat koniński, gmina and parish of Rzgów, with no other information given.

name: Wójtowstwo (Pyzdrskie)
what: Two manor farms on the Warta in the gmina of Dłusk and parish of Pyzdry, 20 versts from Słupca, with 9 houses and 83 inhabitants; the farm Wójtowstwo Pyzdrskie, separated in 1882 from the Rataje estate, has 240 morgi, a water mill and peat deposits.

name: Wymysł
what: A manor farm on the Warta in the gmina of Dłusk and parish of Pyzdry, 18 versts from Słupca, with 1 house and 10 inhabitants.

name: Wyrów
what: A settlement and village (Wyrów Szpitalny) in the gmina of Zbiersk and parish of Stawiszyn, 16 versts from Kalisz, near Stawiszyn, once with a small church of the Holy Spirit and a sixteenth-century hospital, part of the Stawiszyn starosty.

name: Zagórznica (Zagóźnica)
what: A colony in the gmina of Grodziec and parish of Królików, 31 versts from Słupca, with 16 houses and 100 inhabitants.
note: The Słownik prints it twice, as Zagórznica (t. XIV, p. 270) and Zagóźnica (p. 273), with the same figures.

name: Zamość
what: A manor farm on the Prosna in the gmina of Dłusk and parish of Pyzdry, 24 versts from Słupca, with 1 house and 8 inhabitants.

name: Zapowiednia
what: A forest settlement in the gmina of Dłusk and parish of Pyzdry, 24 versts from Słupca; no figures given.

name: Zastruże
what: A village, manor farm and mill in the gmina and parish of Rzgów, powiat koniński, 12 1/2 versts from Konin; the manor farm was separated from the estate of Rzgów in 1868.

name: Zbiersk
what: A village, colony, manor farm and settlement in the gmina and parish of Zbiersk, 21 versts from Kalisz, with 1298 inhabitants in all, a sugar factory and an estate of 3621 morgi owned by Wilhelm Repphan.
note: Its estate listed the farm Miedza and the nomenclatures Leśnictwo and Defet (Defekt).

name: Zielona
what: A settlement in the gmina of Zbiersk and parish of Stawiszyn, 18 versts from Kalisz, with 1 house.

name: Zielona Karczma
what: A 'Zielona Karczma' (inn) in powiat kaliski, gmina and parish of Zbiersk; no figures given.

name: Żdżary
what: A forest settlement in the gmina of Dłusk and parish of Pyzdry, 19 versts from Słupca, with 3 houses.

name: Żyłka
what: A mill settlement on the Warta in the gmina of Dłusk and parish of Pyzdry, 17 versts from Słupca; no figures given.

name: Biała Grodziecka
what: A village and manor farm (with a forest settlement) in the gmina of Grodziec and parish of Królików, 26 versts from Słupca, with 28 houses and 246 inhabitants in the village.

name: Biały dąb
what: A settlement in the gmina of Dłusk and parish of Pyzdry, with 2 houses and 13 inhabitants.
